red.classification: Identified tooling portability defect; Apple-compatible keyword rejection converts a successful generic command into cleanup_failed/2 without allocating PostgreSQL

repair: Enumerate pid,pgid,stat using supported ps columns and inspect each live matching PID with os.getsid. Numeric session equality, recorded group ID and leader birth remain required. Only ProcessLookupError means the snapshotted member has exited; permission/inspection failure and changed session remain errors retaining metadata. Existing bounded group shutdown and postmaster/root checks are unchanged.

references.title: Apple ps keyword table and unknown-keyword error

coverage_limits: Apple-compatible keyword shim on Linux delegates allowed ps commands to the real host ps; os.getsid and owned child processes are real Linux operations. This is not native Darwin runtime coverage. No Mac execution or native non-Linux PostgreSQL coverage.
